top_concerns: Baseline comparison possibly uneven: SAFA-SNN base-session accuracy is 10-20 points above baselines, so last-session gains largely reflect base training; no matched-recipe control
No matched ANN baseline; the SNN-specific components (ZOO only in base session, threshold alignment) are not shown to matter for incremental learning or on-device efficiency
Energy claim (20%) is weak: measured as power x time on a GPU device, Fig. 4 differences are about 10%, no memory/latency measurement despite on-device motivation
Subspace projection (Eq. 14-15) has dimension/invertibility problems; convergence theory (Eq. 11-12) mixes non-convex and convex rates and is inherited from prior work
ZOO vs surrogate gradient not isolated in ablation; inconsistent notation/algorithm (mask, threshold update needing base firing rates); odd parameter counts in Table 3
